correctness.rationale: For each 3-bit row mask g, control T_j=k(g)+εg2 with k=2g1+2g2+g3 and physical Y_j=T_j+√ε g2. Mixed classes of common integer base level k=2 or 3 have probabilities Aν=(8/27)^ν−2(4/27)^ν and Bν=(4/27)^ν−2(2/27)^ν. On either, nonzero sample variance ε² times a binomial variance gives fitted slope (ε+√ε)/ε exactly, hence error −(k−5/3)/√ε and eventual negative corrected Gram. All other finite ordered ν-ensembles have either nondegenerate integer-level sample variance (bounded errors) or a zero-variance tie with declared b=0. Fixed ν makes termwise limit rigorous, so ε MSE→(Aν+16Bν)/9, negative probability→Aν+Bν. Fixed b=1 gives 2ε/(9ν) MSE and positive estimate. Exact fractions ν=2 yield C2=160/6561, negative=40/729, matching original checker. No claim uniform in growing ν.
